title.rw: HTML, CSS n'Ishushanya ry'Imbuga za none

notes.en: HTML stands for HyperText Markup Language. It is the standard markup language for creating web pages. HTML describes the structure of a Web page. HTML consists of a series of elements. Elements tell the browser how to display the content.
notes.rw: HTML isobanura 'HyperText Markup Language'. Ni rurimi rusanzwe rukoreshwa mu kurema imbuga za interineti. HTML isobanura imiterere y'urubuga. HTML igizwe n'uruhererekane ry'ibintu (elements). Ibi bintu bibwira mushakisha (browser) uko ikwiye kwerekana ibikubiyemo.

notes.en: CSS (Cascading Style Sheets) is used to style the HTML elements. It controls the layout, colors, fonts, and overall appearance of a website. CSS can be added to HTML in three ways: Inline, Internal, and External. The most common and recommended way is using External CSS files.
notes.rw: CSS (Cascading Style Sheets) ikoreshwa mu gushushanya ibintu bya HTML. Igenzura imiterere, amabara, inyuguti, n'uko urubuga rugaragara muri rusange. CSS ishobora gushyirwa muri HTML mu buryo butatu: Inline, Internal, n'uburyo bwo hanze (External). Uburyo bwiza kandi bwemewe cyane ni ugukoresha dosiye za CSS zo hanze.
